CREATE TRIGGER assessment_profile_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF assessment_profile ON analysis_batches WHEN NEW.assessment_profile IS NOT OLD.assessment_profile BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ASSESSMENT_PROFILE_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER assessment_profile_supported BEFORE INSERT ON analysis_batches WHEN NEW.assessment_profile NOT IN ('legacy_full_v1','labor_materials_v1') OR NEW.assessment_profile IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ASSESSMENT_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED'); END

CREATE TABLE ai_usage_records (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	file_id VARCHAR(36), 
	provider VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	input_units INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	output_units INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	estimated_cost_usd FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	latency_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (analysis_id, idempotency_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analysis_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES uploaded_files (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE analysis_batches (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	company_display_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	assessment_profile VARCHAR(40) DEFAULT 'legacy_full_v1' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	is_demo BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	purge_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at DATETIME, 
	file_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	employee_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	high_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	medium_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	low_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	insufficient_data_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	coverage_rate FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	progress INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	current_stage VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	failure_reason VARCHAR(200), 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analysis_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE deletion_tombstones (
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	deletion_reason VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (analysis_id)
)

CREATE TABLE employee_match_candidates (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	file_id VARCHAR(36), 
	candidate_employee_id VARCHAR(36), 
	extracted_fields JSON NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analysis_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES uploaded_files (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(candidate_employee_id) REFERENCES employees (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE employee_match_decisions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	candidate_id VARCHAR(36), 
	decision VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_employee_id VARCHAR(36), 
	corrected_fields JSON NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_employee_match_decision_candidate UNIQUE (candidate_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analysis_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(candidate_id) REFERENCES employee_match_candidates (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_employee_id) REFERENCES employees (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE employees (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	masked_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	normalized_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	employee_number VARCHAR(80), 
	id_number_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	phone_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	bank_card_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	department VARCHAR(100), 
	job_title VARCHAR(100), 
	employment_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	hire_date DATE, 
	termination_date DATE, 
	match_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (analysis_id, employee_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analysis_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE employment_facts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	employee_id VARCHAR(36), 
	file_id VARCHAR(36), 
	fact_type VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	value_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	normalized_value_json JSON NOT NULL, 
	extraction_method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	verification_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	dedupe_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (analysis_id, dedupe_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analysis_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(employee_id) REFERENCES employees (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES uploaded_files (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE finding_reviews (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	finding_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	old_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	new_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	note VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(finding_id) REFERENCES risk_findings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE parsed_blocks (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	document_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	block_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	locator JSON NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES parsed_documents (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE parsed_documents (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	file_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	parser_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	parser_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	detected_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	needs_vision BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	warnings JSON NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (file_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES uploaded_files (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE processing_jobs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	file_id VARCHAR(36), 
	job_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	unique_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(100), 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (unique_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analysis_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES uploaded_files (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE risk_findings (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	employee_id VARCHAR(36), 
	rule_id VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	rule_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	assessment_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	review_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	trigger_fact_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	source_locator_ids JSON NOT NULL, 
	missing_fact_types JSON NOT NULL, 
	legal_basis JSON NOT NULL, 
	recommended_actions JSON NOT NULL, 
	requires_human_review BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	due_date DATE, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	is_current BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	retired_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (analysis_id, employee_id, rule_id, rule_version), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_risk_findings_assessment_status CHECK (assessment_status IN ('management_reminder', 'confirmed_anomaly', 'suspected_risk', 'insufficient_data', 'requires_human_review')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analysis_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(employee_id) REFERENCES employees (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE source_locators (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	file_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	fact_id VARCHAR(36), 
	locator_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	location JSON NOT NULL, 
	excerpt TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analysis_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(file_id) REFERENCES uploaded_files (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(fact_id) REFERENCES employment_facts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE uploaded_files (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	analysis_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	original_filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	storage_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	mime_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	extension VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	detected_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	classified_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	page_count INTEGER, 
	progress INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(80), 
	purge_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (analysis_id, sha256), 
	FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES analysis_batches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (storage_key)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_risk_findings_analysis_current ON risk_findings (analysis_id, is_current)
